Source: supplied organizer brief, Doc/Dainik Bhaskar Game Lab 2026.pdf, pp. 6–7, 9–11 and 13–18. The brief asks for a game for a news platform. Dainik Bhaskar Khel is our proposed collection as one submission concept, not a claim that the organizer requested five games.
Design basis: Focus on NITI Game, conversation 6aca000c-84c4-83ee-83e8-55c5003f4998, and user refinements on 13 October 2026. Intended benefits are design hypotheses, not measured audience outcomes.
Opening: The reader already has a reason to open Dainik Bhaskar. Our idea is to give that everyday visit a small moment of participation. Dainik Bhaskar Khel brings short games into that news habit, with different payoffs connected through one daily experience.
The reader comes for news

A few minutes over lunch.
A cricket score to discuss.
The brief describes mobile-first Hindi readers who are mostly casual players or new to games.
Our starting point is a familiar action that fits the time they already have.
The design response

Clear Hindi instructions

A short, satisfying finish

A useful or enjoyable payoff
Target session: about 1–3 minutes

Source: supplied organizer brief, Doc/Dainik Bhaskar Game Lab 2026.pdf, pp. 6–7, 9–11 and 13–18. The brief asks for a game for a news platform. Dainik Bhaskar Khel is our proposed collection as one submission concept, not a claim that the organizer requested five games.
The lunch-break example draws on the Rajesh persona, p. 13. The preference for accessible Hindi follows the audience brief and persona range. The 1–3 minute session length is a design target, not a measured completion time. Carrom can take longer with unlimited attempts.
Presenter: Rajesh follows cricket and checks his phone during short breaks. He does not need to decide to become a gamer. An invitation tied to what he already cares about can be enough.

title: Aaj Ki Niti: the thought travels further

text: Aaj Ki Niti: the thought travels further
The idea began with a morning thought shared in a family WhatsApp group.
Complete the thought

Make something worth sending
Create a Hindi card with clear attribution and Dainik Bhaskar identity.
A share card from the prototype

alt: A share card from the prototype

text:
Design basis: Focus on NITI Game, conversation 6aca000c-84c4-83ee-83e8-55c5003f4998, and user refinements on 13 October 2026. Intended benefits are design hypotheses, not measured audience outcomes.
Source: Doc/Dainik Bhaskar Daily Games Design Rationale.md records the personal spark of seeing an older uncle share a morning thought on WhatsApp. This is a design observation, not population research. Sources: niti.html and its supplied share-card screen. Original writing must remain labeled as original. A hosted invitation is a production extension.
Presenter: The starting observation was simple: the value of a morning thought was in sending it to someone. Niti makes the reader participate before sharing. Complete the thought, understand it, then make a card that feels worth sending. The relationship to Dainik Bhaskar is trust and a daily ritual. It does not require a forced headline.
Image source: supplied project screenshot, Doc/review-images/niti-card-with-meaning.png. Saved prototype screen, not a fresh end-to-end test.

title: Aaj Ka Over: the reader takes the field

text: Aaj Ka Over: the reader takes the field
A sports story creates the invitation. Six balls make it playable.
A clear role and a clear finish
Choose batting or bowling, read the target, then time the action.
Back to the match
The result offers a route to the real story. New match contexts refresh the same familiar controls.
Prototype: a six-ball practice scenario

Design basis: Focus on NITI Game, conversation 6aca000c-84c4-83ee-83e8-55c5003f4998, and user refinements on 13 October 2026. Intended benefits are design hypotheses, not measured audience outcomes.
Sources: Superover.html and Doc/Asian Games 2026 match context.md. Current gameplay offers batting/bowling and authored 18/15-run practice settings. Do not call those settings verified historical final-over equations. This slide makes no external match-result claim.
Presenter: Cricket offers a natural invitation from a sports story: how would you handle six balls of pressure? The player bats or bowls, then can return to match coverage. Keep the player’s simulation separate from the real result. Verified historical final-over equations are an extension, not a claim about the current authored targets.
Image source: supplied project screenshot, Doc/review-images/superover-bowling-position.jpg. Saved prototype screen, not a fresh end-to-end test.

title: Aaj Ki Jodi: connections behind the news

text: Aaj Ki Jodi: connections behind the news

Eight cards. Four relationships.
A reason behind every match.
Match, then understand
Connect a person with an achievement or an event with its place. Reveal why that relationship matters.
The story continues in reporting
Each pair has context and a relevant source. New editorial packs give the format a fresh subject.
Archive example: the matching interaction

Design basis: Focus on NITI Game, conversation 6aca000c-84c4-83ee-83e8-55c5003f4998, and user refinements on 13 October 2026. Intended benefits are design hypotheses, not measured audience outcomes.
Sources: jodo.html and public/jodo-content.js, revision 2026-10-13.1. The prototype contains sourced archive and evergreen editions. The screenshot depicts an earlier space matching edition and illustrates the interaction only. Current-news and city editions need an editorial publishing workflow.
Presenter: A name in a headline is easier to understand when you know what it connects to. Jodi asks the reader to make that connection, then explains why it matters. The same matching format can carry sports, science, service news or local developments. The article provides the detail that four pairs cannot.
Image source: supplied project screenshot, Doc/review-images/family-jodo.jpg. Saved prototype screen, not a fresh end-to-end test.

Carrom board from the prototype

Source: supplied organizer brief, Doc/Dainik Bhaskar Game Lab 2026.pdf, pp. 6–7, 9–11 and 13–18. The brief asks for a game for a news platform. Dainik Bhaskar Khel is our proposed collection as one submission concept, not a claim that the organizer requested five games.
Design basis: Focus on NITI Game, conversation 6aca000c-84c4-83ee-83e8-55c5003f4998, and user refinements on 13 October 2026. Intended benefits are design hypotheses, not measured audience outcomes.
Carrom appears in the Ram Kishore persona on p. 14, not as evidence of universal familiarity. Source: Carrom_Puzzles.html inspected 13 October 2026. It now preserves coin progress across normal misses, counts shots, and records first completion and replay best. An invalidating foul resets the board while retaining the total. Screenshot predates the new counter.
Presenter: Sometimes the reader wants a break from reading. Carrom gives us a familiar physical action without needing a board or another player. A small daily layout makes it a challenge with a finish. Everyone can keep trying. The next question is whether they can complete that same board in fewer shots.
Image source: supplied project screenshot, Doc/review-images/family-carrom.jpg. Saved prototype screen, not a fresh end-to-end test.

title: The story and the game stay connected

text: The story and the game stay connected
An invitation in context
A cricket story can invite a six-ball challenge. A word or news connection can invite a small discovery.
A result with somewhere to go
Meaning and a relevant story preview give the reader a reason to continue reading.
Reading remains a choice. Returning to the game keeps the reader’s progress.
The prototype’s sample news journey

Design basis: Focus on NITI Game, conversation 6aca000c-84c4-83ee-83e8-55c5003f4998, and user refinements on 13 October 2026. Intended benefits are design hypotheses, not measured audience outcomes.
Sources: Doc/Opening and news journey revision.md, src/ui/news-reader.js and supplied saved news screen. The production proposition places relevant invitations in the Dainik Bhaskar feed and article endings. The web prototype demonstrates a local news journey, not integration into the live Dainik Bhaskar app.
Presenter: The collection has a home, but the invitation can appear in the story the reader is already following. Play gives that reader a new way into the subject, and the result offers the reporting again. News supplies context. The game supplies participation. Neither route needs to force the other.
Image source: supplied project screenshot, Doc/review-images/stories-simplified-360.jpg. Saved prototype screen, not a fresh end-to-end test.

Design basis: Focus on NITI Game, conversation 6aca000c-84c4-83ee-83e8-55c5003f4998, and user refinements on 13 October 2026. Intended benefits are design hypotheses, not measured audience outcomes.
Sources: src/systems/progression.js, src/ui/torch.js and src/screens/hub.js. Daily participation follows completing any one game. Replays do not increment the daily streak twice. The mashal is a product metaphor, not a claim of tested cultural comprehension.

Sources inspected: src/screens/hub.js, wordal.html, niti.html, Superover.html, Carrom_Puzzles.html, jodo.html, public/jodo-content.js and src/systems/progression.js. This is source inspection and saved screen evidence, not a fresh functional QA certification. No adoption, retention or comprehension uplift is claimed.
Presenter: The web prototype demonstrates the connected journey: choose a game, play, see a meaningful result, and continue into a story or a share. Moving into Dainik Bhaskar would add newsroom publishing, hosted sharing and audience validation. We would measure voluntary return and useful story engagement, with comprehension checks for Jodi.

Design basis: Focus on NITI Game, conversation 6aca000c-84c4-83ee-83e8-55c5003f4998, and user refinements on 13 October 2026. Intended benefits are design hypotheses, not measured audience outcomes.
Closing: We began with the small moments already in a news reader’s day. Dainik Bhaskar Khel gives those moments an action and a payoff. The submission is one connected play destination with five short games.
Suggested demonstration: open the shared home; solve or reveal the labelled Shabd demo; open the related story and return; show the Niti card; show Jodi context and a Carrom shot total. Demonstrate only behavior available in the running prototype.
